crime_highlights: The appellant came through a rear door of a home, entered a bedroom where the female complainant was asleep
he threatened to use a weapon
He had cut a phone line in the house
the assault had a serious effect on the complainant, who thereafter was fearful for her safety
rationale_highlights: This young appellant, who has also had alcohol problems, has an aboriginal background.
persuades me that a somewhat shorter sentence may achieve the sentencing purposes of deterrence and rehabilitation
Substantially based on the particular circumstances of this young aboriginal offender, I would substitute for the sentence of 6 years a sentence of 4 years.
note: Appeal court; background described in para 7, effect stated in para 10.

crime_highlights: Mr. Reid assaulted S.R. with a knife
Mr. Reid striking and kicking the victim and stabbing her three times with knife
All of the wounds required stitches
he threatened her with further harm if she implicated Mr. Reid in the assault
rationale_highlights: Mr. Reid has the support of many people in the community, including the Heiltsuk Justice Advisory Committee

the new information available to this Court, when considered in light of the principles expressed in such cases as Gladue, Wells and Proulx, justifies the court in finding that a term of imprisonment in excess of two years is not required to meet the factors of sentencing
note: Gladue link is thin; mainly community support and new evidence.

crime_highlights: the accused launched, apparently without any kind of provocation, an attack upon Barker with a table leg
he did succeed in causing extremely serious injuries
He told the clerk that he was there to rob him and that he wanted to go back to jail
rationale_highlights: It is difficult to imagine that any judge could have more fully considered the particular aspects of this aboriginal person's difficulties
the degree of restraint shown was surely very high
He sought to balance that with rehabilitation, with careful regard to aboriginal status.
note: Appeal court affirms trial judge considered Gladue; offender history is in para 6, not included.
